name: Spearhead through your Heart
source:
A visual novel about war, with bonding characters and an emotional unique history

You will incarnate a soviet soldier in Stalingrad, and will get to go through the second part of the war, interact with bonding characters and historical facts to enjoy and learn.

[From [url=https://totsugeki-studio.itch.io/spearhead-through-your-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于战争的视觉小说，描写人物间的羁绊，并呈现一段独特而动人的历史。

你将化身为一名身处斯大林格勒的苏联士兵，经历战争后半段，与角色建立羁绊，并通过历史事件获得知识与体验。

[来源：[url=https://totsugeki-studio.itch.io/spearhead-through-your-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
